listing.title: My First Music Coloring Book
listing.subtitle: 30 Big & Easy Instruments and Music Things – Drum, Guitar, Piano, Maracas & More for Kids Ages 2-5
listing.author: JONNY COLOR
listing.description_html:
Big, bold and easy to color: a first coloring book full of friendly music makers!

Little hands color 30 cute pages of instruments and music things, from a drum, a guitar and maracas to a piano, a trumpet and a singing bird. Every page has one big, simple picture with extra-thick lines, many with happy faces, so small hands can color inside the lines, and each picture's name is written in big letters to color too.

Inside you'll find:

  • Instruments to bang, tap and shake: Drum, Bongos, Maracas, Tambourine, Cymbals, Triangle, Bell, Rattle and Xylophone
  • Instruments to strum, pluck and play: Guitar, Ukulele, Banjo, Violin, Harp, Piano, Keyboard and Accordion
  • Instruments to blow: Trumpet, Trombone, Tuba, Saxophone, Recorder, Harmonica and Whistle
  • Music things: Microphone, Headphones, Radio, Music Box, Music Notes and a Singing Bird
  • One large picture per page with thick outlines
  • Single-sided pages with a blank back, so markers won't bleed onto the next picture
  • Big 8.5 x 11 inch pages and a "Great job!" certificate at the end

A fun, screen-free activity for toddlers and preschoolers ages 2 to 5.

Part of the my first step series.
